label: prf:pauli-factor-wedderburn
title: Proof of pauli factor wedderburn
html:
Proof. Proof of pauli factor wedderburn

Proof. By (confinement = spectral collapse), the Frobenius integral factors through the centre as \int_A = \mu \circ \pi_Z with \pi_Z(a) = \sum_\lambda e_\lambda \cdot a \cdot e_\lambda. Restricting to the two extremal partitions \lambda = (1^n) (alternating) and \lambda = (n) (trivial), the [n]_q! factor cancels in the ratio. \square

Specialisation to H_3(R, q). The three irreps are V_{(3)} (sym, dim 1), V_{(2,1)} (std, dim 2), V_{(1^3)} (alt, dim 1). Both extremal q-dimensions equal 1, so for \beta_\mathcal{K} \in B_3

  F_{\mathrm{Pauli}}(\beta_\mathcal{K})
  \;=\;
  \frac{\chi_{(1^3)}(\beta_\mathcal{K})}
       {\chi_{(3)}(\beta_\mathcal{K})}.

This recovers the working definition of F_{\mathrm{Pauli}} in the certificate engine (mass-formula validation) and identifies it as a Wedderburn-block trace ratio rather than a posited statistical weight.
